as_told.title: Pat Price finds a Soviet submarine with a UFO tracking it
as_told.place_text: Ocean location of a Russian 'boomer' submarine

plain: A podcast guest named Dan Sheehan tells of Pat Price, a man in 1970s research into remote viewing, the attempt to see distant places with the mind, alongside researchers Russell Targ and Ingo Swann. According to Sheehan, citing reports by Swann, Price located a Soviet "boomer," a submarine carrying nuclear missiles, somewhere at sea, and saw a huge UFO hovering over the water above it, tracking and watching it, which would mean something was keeping an eye on nuclear weapons.
